programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You never think that a loved one could hurt, or even destroy, your family. That's exactly what happened to Donna and her two daughters, whose story begins in a small Oklahoma town in the heartland of America. Donna dated Jerry for five years. He wouldn’t let her break off their relationship and when she finally did, no one could have predicted the lengths to which Jerry would go to hurt her. This real-life drama unfolded with horror, violence and unimaginable twists. See what good Dr. Phil believes can come from this unthinkable tragedy. Is there hope for this family’s recovery?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: No matter how hard we try to protect ourselves, all of us will experience an unexpected trauma in our lives. Whether it's divorce, an illness or a violent attack, each one of us is a potential victim. When misfortune befalls you, how should you react? Will this be something that poisons you for the rest of your life, or will it be something that you adapt to in a way that you can move on? If you're struggling to overcome a trauma, learn to take back control, stop fueling irrational fears and move forward with your life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two of this series, Rheta says her deceitful, backstabbing, meddling mother-in-law, Deb, is going to destroy her marriage if her husband, Mark, doesn't cut the cord. Rheta says she's so fed up with their mother-and-son bond that she's filed for divorce, shredded her wedding vows and has even come to blows with Deb on several occasions. Mark agrees that his mother is too involved, but can he break ties while Deb holds the purse strings? Does paying the couple's rent and providing them with a car give Deb license to criticize Rheta and try to set Mark up with other women? Rheta says that on some days, she and Mark are best friends, but their arguments get so heated that they've turned physical -- in front of their three children. Will a grand gesture from Mark keep Rheta from walking away? Can Rheta and Deb mend fences?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two, will accused liar Sarah, who fibbed about having cancer, miscarriage and muscular dystrophy, change her ways?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two families send desperate pleas asking Dr. Phil to help their teen daughters. First, Deanna and Michael say their 15-year-old daughter, Miranda, is out of control. They say they’ve discovered that she’s engaging in cybersex, sending and receiving nude photos on her phone, and has even run away four times -- once to meet up with a 29-year-old man, with whom they say she had a sexual relationship. In an effort to tame the teen, they say they've taken away her phone and iPod and revoked Internet privileges. Deanna says she even quit her job to stay home and keep tabs on Miranda, but nothing has helped. Miranda says she wants to be loved by an adult male, and if she has to have sex to feel loved, then she will. How is Michael's role in his daughter’s life influencing her decisions? Dr. Phil gives the teen's dad a wake-up call. Then, Dawn and John say that their adopted 13-year-old daughter lies, steals and shows no remorse for her actions. Among her offenses, they say she ordered 77 adult movies and was playing a sexually inappropriate game with her 7-year-old brother. In an effort to protect their other children, the couple sent her to a facility for troubled teens. John says he doesn’t want her to come home after her treatment, but Dawn disagrees, and it’s tearing their marriage apart. How can they save their daughter without destroying their marriage?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The exclusive interview with a woman who was held captive in a closet.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine hearing voices that don't exist, thinking neighbors were controlling your behavior with magnetic waves, or that people on television were sending you secret messages. What if you constantly thought someone was following you, trying to poison you, out to get you? For those who suffer from schizophrenia, delusions and paranoia are part of daily life. Dr. Phil sheds light on a disease that is both complex and frightening.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort, a young man who was abducted by a family friend when he was 11 years old, reunites two decades later with the FBI agent that he says saved his life. Go inside the dramatic rescue of Tony from a convicted sex offender. Plus, Alicia Kozak says she was just 13 when she was lured from her home by an internet predator and placed in a dog collar, chained to the floor, and horrifically abused. Hear her inspiring story of survival.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with three couples on the verge of ending their marriages.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three friends confront former friend, Sarah, who faked terminal cancer, miscarriages, and used a wheelchair to pretend she had muscular dystrophy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Choose My Husband or My Boyfriend?
programme.desc: A woman says she can't choose between her husband or boyfriend.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil advises parents struggling to raise teens in an image-focused culture.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your pregnant teen daughter running away to be with the baby's father -- an older man whom she met online. For Heidi, this became reality when her 15-year-old daughter, Brittney, went missing for five weeks. Dr. Phil put private investigator and former FBI Agent Harold Copus on the case to find the missing teen. See the confrontation when Harold finally locates her and her 34-year-old boyfriend. Then, find out why Brittney was even more upset when she found out what was in store for her. It's been two months; has Brittney's relationship with her mother improved? Next, Kim, 15, has run away six times in the last year, most recently making it halfway across the country to be with her married boyfriend. Why didn't her parents look for her, and why does she say she'll do anything to get away from them? Can this family learn to get things back on track? Think your child is being targeted by a sexual predator? Don’t miss Dr. Phil’s warning signs!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Will Mooching Kyle Finally Move Out?
programme.desc: Parents get help to deal with a mooching son.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From the outside, Tayler's life seemed picture perfect -- but no one could have imagined the disturbing secrets she was hiding behind her smile. From the ages of 6 to 17, Tayler says her dad, Russell, molested her, gave her drugs, and took her to Mexico on numerous occasions, where she was forced to do unspeakable things. How could these horrific events have occurred without anyone noticing? Tayler's mom, Deanna, says she was unaware of the alleged abuse, and just thought Tayler and her father had a special father-daughter bond. Were there warning signs she missed? Now 19 and addicted to heroin, Tayler says she feels alone, abandoned and confused -- but she also admits that she misses her father. Can Dr. Phil help get her on a path to both emotional and physical recovery? Then, hear from Tayler's two younger sisters. What did they witness? Were they being groomed by their father? And, where is Russell today? If you're a parent, tune in to learn how to protect your child from a predator.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Eighteen-year-old Atira is being accused of tearing her family apart. Her mother, Yolanda, sister, Alexa, and brother, Stuart, say the young mom is a "lazy slob," who yells, shoves and cusses, and they’re tired of the chaos she creates. Atira admits she’s full of anger but says her family makes no effort to understand her. Is Atira just an out-of-control, bratty teen, or is a dark secret from her past causing her to lash out? When Dr. Phil digs into this family’s history, will Yolanda, Alexa and Stuart begin to better understand Atira? Then, Atira confronts Yolanda for ignoring her cries for help as a child. Where was her mom when she says she needed her most? Will mother and daughter find a common ground on which to rebuild their relationship? Then, former prosecutor Loni Coombs, author of the new book, “You’re Perfect” ... and Other Lies Parents Tell, joins Dr. Phil. Learn about her six parenting tips for effective listening. Plus, find out how a marshmallow can help you learn critical information about your child’s future, and the most important thing Dr. Phil says you must do with your child every day.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, viewers met 21-year-old Bailey who says she has the greatest love story of the century. She says she met Jasmine on social media eight months ago and that it was love at first post. She says they’ve been communicating day and night but have never spoken on the phone and have never met. When Dr. Phil first tried to talk to Bailey, she became insistent that her mother, Ericka, not participate in the show, and Bailey angrily walked off the stage. Bailey decided to come back to tell Dr. Phil she wants to meet Jasmine for the first time because she has something important to tell her. Will Dr. Phil allow Bailey to meet the target of her obsession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when your perfect wedding day turns into a perfect nightmare? One bride fainted on her walk down the aisle and cries every time she thinks about it. Now, Dr. Phil gives her a second chance to say, “I do.” Another guest was so stressed out about fitting into a tiny gown that she became anorexic. But is her eating disorder just a symptom of a deeper issue? Plus, “Wedding Etiquette” author Peggy Post helps one shy bride overcome her fear of being in the spotlight on her wedding day.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Exclusive: The Co-Eds And The Catfish
programme.desc: In one of the most twisted and bizarre love deceptions ever covered on Dr. Phil, seven female college students from Brigham Young University face the man they say they fell in love with online but never met in person. In a surprising twist, their one-time Prince Charming reveals that he, too, was victimized by a catfish who stole his identity. Tune in as the real person who lured these young women into fake relationships comes forward. Who would orchestrate such a tangled web of deception and why? Can these co-eds find forgiveness and gain closure?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: John says that when his ex-wife, Laurie, moved 1,500 miles away to be with her boyfriend, Joe, she abandoned her children, and he was left to raise the couple’s three boys -- Johnny, 14, and twins Christopher and Alexander, 12 -- on his own. The single dad proudly proclaims that being a committed father makes him “one in a million” -- but is John really in over his head? John admits the boys disrespect his authority and recently, he says Alexander punched him in the face and gave him a black eye. Laurie says her children tell her that they aren’t happy living with their father, and she denies deserting her children -- but is she willing to step up and take Dr. Phil’s advice? Then, hear from the three boys. What do they reveal about their home life? And, is this a case of clueless parenting -- or unruly kids? No parent can afford to miss this all-new Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Son Picked the Wrong Fiance
programme.desc: For the first time, a woman meets her soon-to-be daughter-in-law, whom she has called manipulative, immoral and disrespectful.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How would your life change if Publisher’s Clearing House rang your doorbell? A scenario many of us would like to live out, but for some, sudden wealth has been a double edged sword. Tune in as families tell Dr. Phil their tales of fast fortunes and the pain it’s caused. You’ll meet two sisters – one was on the verge of financial disaster as the other received an unexpected windfall. It’s been nothing but heartache since, and their love and trust for one another is now bankrupt. Plus, you’ll meet two families who received millions from a casino slot machine only to have their happiness robbed by the “one armed bandits.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know someone who turns your stomach or makes you cringe the minute he or she walks into the room? Dr. Phil talks to guests who say their relative's rude behavior keeps them on edge.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Twenty-one-year-old Bailey says eight months ago, she “liked” a tweet from a complete stranger and it was love at first post. Bailey says their romance is like no other love story you’ve ever heard, but the shocking thing is this stranger has never met Bailey, and she wants her to stop sending thousands of messages professing her love. Bailey’s mom, Ericka, says she’s lost her daughter to this fixation she has with this stranger, and she wants her daughter back. When Bailey finds out she will be sharing the stage with her mom, Bailey storms off because she says she hates her mom. Will she come back and talk to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These guests say their lives are spinning out of control! Teresa says she’s clumsy and tired of tripping, falling, and hurting herself. Will she always be an accident waiting to happen? Then, meet a stay-at-home mom whose clutter crisis has her kids leaping and climbing over things just to get around the house! Why does she choose to be the queen of chaos? Plus, a husband’s do-it-yourself repairs are turning his home upside down. His wife is fed up and wants Dr. Phil to “fix” him!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Are My Children in a Cult?
programme.desc: A father is fighting for custody of his 4 children because his ex-wife is allegedly in a cult.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You never think that a loved one could hurt, or even destroy, your family. That's exactly what happened to Donna and her two daughters, whose story begins in a small Oklahoma town in the heartland of America. Donna dated Jerry for five years. He wouldn’t let her break off their relationship and when she finally did, no one could have predicted the lengths to which Jerry would go to hurt her. This real-life drama unfolded with horror, violence and unimaginable twists. See what good Dr. Phil believes can come from this unthinkable tragedy. Is there hope for this family’s recovery?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On July 6, 2012, 16-year-old Skylar Neese was stabbed to death by her two best friends, Shelia Eddy and Rachel Shoaf. Six months later, Rachel confessed to police and led them to Skylar’s remains. Shelia continued to plead not guilty -- until January 2014, when she finally admitted her part in the brutal murder. Both teens claimed they killed Skylar because they “didn’t want to be friends with her anymore” -- but was that their real motive? And, who was the mastermind behind the plot? Dr. Phil sits down with Sklylar’s parents, Dave and Mary, who say they’re struggling to comprehend what happened to their little girl. How can they heal after such a horrific tragedy? And, how could Shelia -- who had been friends with Skylar since she was 8 -- and Rachel commit such a heinous crime? Hear from Shelia’s cousin, who says Shelia isn’t the monster people say she is. And, friends of Rachel’s family weigh in. Were there any red flags they say they missed? Then, a close friend of Shelia and Skylar claims she knows the real reason behind the murder. Does Skylar’s journal entry confirm her suspicions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2010, 24-year-old Michelle O’Connell was found shot to death in what authorities ruled a suicide -- a case that was recently ordered reopened by the governor of Florida. Michelle’s mother, Patricia, and sister, Jennifer, insist the young mother never would have taken her own life, and they believe Michelle’s boyfriend, Jeremy -- a sheriff’s deputy -- killed her, which he denies. Michelle’s brother, Scott -- also a sheriff’s deputy -- supports Jeremy and says his mother and sister need to stop living in denial. How does he answer his mother’s accusation that he’s betraying his family to save his job? Dr. Phil brings this fractured family together in search of answers. What happened to Michelle that night? Hear from one of the first responders on the scene -- why does she believe the initial finding of suicide was wrong? Plus, can this family put their differences aside and come together and grieve for Michelle?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: An Unsolved Murder, A Family Divided
programme.desc: In August 2009, Penny’s 40-year-old sister, Shannon, a successful businesswoman, was found dead in her car, at the bottom of a cliff, in what authorities initially believed was a tragic accident but later ruled a homicide -- a case that remains unsolved. Emotions run high when Penny faces her father, Ted, for the first time in two years and drops a bombshell: She believes he hired a hitman to kill Shannon. Ted admits his relationship with Shannon was strained at the time, but he vehemently denies he had anything to do with her death. How will Ted react to Penny’s accusation? Tune in to watch the drama unfold as this father and daughter angrily level charges against each other -- can Penny and Ted find a way to repair their relationship, or have the accusations gone too far?

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E32: El estago de grace
programme.desc: Un padre afligido se niega a aceptar la pérdida de su hijo, presuntamente muerto por el bombardeo de una clínica en África. Cuando el hijo regresa a casa milagrosamente, su madre lentamente comienza a sospechar la verdad: el amor eterno de su padre ha resucitado a los muertos vivientes.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E43: Fiebre de encierro
programme.desc: Después de que el asesino de su esposa finalmente es sentenciado, un hombre comienza a tener visiones del crimen, revelando una verdad horrible que ha logrado ocultarse a sí mismo.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E38: Cenizas del pasado
programme.desc: Un director ejecutivo despiadado reúne a tres de sus ejecutivos para un juego de póquer muy inusual, cuyas apuestas demuestran ser más de lo que nadie esperaba.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E40: Negacion
programme.desc: Un joven sacerdote desilusionado es enviado a hacerse cargo de una parroquia moribunda, pero descubre que su presencia es resentida por el sacerdote mayor. El joven sacerdote pronto se ve perseguido por el fantasma de una niña que dejó atrás para unirse al clero.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E39: Todo para el ganador
programme.desc: Art Jones, que ha fingido su muerte en una tormenta de nieve en la montaña y mató a su guía de escalada en el proceso, se esconde en una isla tropical humeante, a la espera de un pago de seguro considerable. Después de ocho meses de aislamiento, Art ahora está siendo atormentado por el fantasma del guía de escalada, quien durante una ola de calor abrasador convierte la choza de Art en una congelada jaula de culpa.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E42: Foto de despedida
programme.desc: La experiencia de haber quedado atrapada en un edificio derrumbado ha dejado a Kate Bradshaw claustrofóbica y muda. Mientras un guardia de seguridad descontento la retiene como rehén en un ascensor, Kate se enfrenta a su peor miedo y logra invertir la situación, triunfando sobre su captor y recuperando su voz.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E41: Borrada
programme.desc: Encerrada en un matrimonio rancio con su deslucido esposo, una mujer obsesionada con la juventud comienza a sospechar que él está creando una mujer joven para reemplazarla. Cuando comienza a desaparecer, se entera demasiado tarde de que la mujer es en realidad la versión más joven de sí misma, de la que su esposo se enamoró hace muchos años.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E36: Consumidor
programme.desc: Una vieja viuda demacrada es asesinada por su sobrina engañada y su joven novio, solo para volver a perseguirlos en los espejos.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E37: Solo es una pelicula
programme.desc: Una dueña de tugurios, condenada a arresto domiciliario en su propia propiedad decrépita, es perseguida por los espectros de los inquilinos que sufrieron y murieron en el edificio.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E44: Baja
programme.desc: Habiéndose perdido la foto perfecta de una celebridad a la que ha perseguido durante años, un paparazza busca la toma definitiva: la celebridad ahora muerta que yace en el estado en una funeraria. Pero después de finalmente hacerse una idea, descubre que el fantasma de la celebridad comienza a acosarla sin descanso.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E35: La herencia
programme.desc: Una pareja afroamericana está aterrorizada en su nuevo hogar por el fantasma de un hombre racista. Al final, descubrimos el verdadero motivo del fantasma: incapaz de descansar en paz, ha estado buscando el perdón de sus pecados.

programme.desc: Habiéndose perdido la foto perfecta de una celebridad a la que ha perseguido durante años, un paparazza busca la toma definitiva: la celebridad ahora muerta que yace en el estado en una funeraria. Pero después de finalmente hacerse una idea, descubre que el fantasma de la celebridad comienza a acosarla sin descanso.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E35: La herencia
programme.desc: Una pareja afroamericana está aterrorizada en su nuevo hogar por el fantasma de un hombre racista. Al final, descubrimos el verdadero motivo del fantasma: incapaz de descansar en paz, ha estado buscando el perdón de sus pecados.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E31: La mansion del terror
programme.desc: Un hombre arrastra a su esposa de regreso al vecindario idealizado de su juventud, pero un viaje a la vieja casa de la diversión del paseo marítimo brinda una visión aterradora de un pasado que es mejor olvidar.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E27: Espejito espejito
programme.desc: Al final de la Guerra Civil, una mujer afligida, cuyo marido ha desaparecido en combate, espera a un médico para atender a su hijo enfermo. Para empeorar las cosas, el niño ha tenido visiones del Ángel de la Muerte llegando a su puerta, y cuando aparece un soldado misterioso buscando refugio, los temores de la mujer comienzan a aumentar. Al final, resulta ser un caso de identidad equivocada: el médico mismo es el Ángel de la Muerte, que ha venido a llevarse a la mujer, no a su hijo.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E33: Corazon enfermo
programme.desc: Una joven pareja cruel libra una ruidosa campaña de terror para desalojar a una anciana de su dúplex. La anciana muere, solo para volver a recibir la retribución exacta de sus torturadores.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E30: Bendigame padre
programme.desc: Un hombre asiático, refugiado del régimen asesino de su tierra natal, es perseguido por un trío de escuadrones de la muerte, todos los cuales fueron ejecutados hace años.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E26: La nueva ninera
programme.desc: Un asistente, que trabaja en un garaje subterráneo, se encuentra atrapado en un inframundo de pesadilla.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E25: Te oi decir mi nombre
programme.desc: Una mujer es salvada del suicidio por un misterioso farero con más en su mente que su salvación.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E29: La casa de los lamentos
programme.desc: Un joven consigue trabajo en el turno de noche en un supermercado frecuentado por ancianos del barrio. Para su horror, descubre que no están comprando cremas para dentaduras postizas y baterías para audífonos, sino que los cuerpos jóvenes se apoderen de ellos y los habiten.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E28: En secreto
programme.desc: Joey Howell, fanático de las películas de terror hastiado y extraordinario empleado de una tienda de videos, gana un premio fantástico de manos de su estrella favorita de películas de terror “B”, Mindy McCobb: el papel de un extra en su película más reciente. Pero cuando llega al set, Joey descubre que las cosas no son lo que parecen. La película se está representando de verdad, y él será la víctima estrella.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E34: A las puertas de la muerte
programme.desc: Un padre afligido se niega a aceptar la pérdida de su hijo, presuntamente muerto por el bombardeo de una clínica en África. Cuando el hijo regresa a casa milagrosamente, su madre lentamente comienza a sospechar la verdad: el amor eterno de su padre ha resucitado a los muertos vivientes.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E16: Almas gemelas
programme.desc: Un ladrón, decidido a robar joyas valiosas de la sala de almacenamiento de una morgue de la ciudad, se enamora de un extraño asistente de la morgue, una mujer que se siente menos cómoda con los vivos que con los muertos.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E17: Cuidado con la musa
programme.desc: Un joven mago y su ambiciosa esposa son invitados a la casa de un gran maestro jubilado. Con la esperanza de descubrir el secreto del famoso acto de ensartar espadas del maestro mago, la pareja obtiene más de lo que esperaban.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E19: Distraccio fatal
programme.desc: Un buen hombre que ha hecho cosas terribles descubre que su conciencia tiene una forma única de delatarse, lo quiera o no.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E21: El paisaje de los amores perdidos
programme.desc: Un asistente de hospital solitario se enamora de una hermosa mujer que resulta estar en coma. A la Bella Durmiente, sus sentimientos por ella la despiertan, pero solo él puede verla despierta.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E31: La mansion del terror

programme.title: Todo me pasa a mí
programme.desc: Un grupo de seis amigos está a las puertas de la boda de uno de ellos, Ángel. Para la reunión llega de su viaje a la India uno de los amigos, Óscar, quien gracias -o para su pesar- a lo asimilado en aquellas tierras, infunde en el resto un aura de misticismo que irá provocando que cada uno se comporte tal cual es en el fondo, dando lugar a declaraciones y situaciones inesperadas.

programme.title: Antes que cante el gallo
programme.desc: La adolescente Carmín ve desvanecerse su sueño de mudarse a la ciudad junto a su madre Doris, quien decide partir a Estados Unidos con su nuevo esposo. Ahora, Carmín crece y vive en Barranquitas, un pintoresco pueblo montañoso en el centro de Puerto Rico, bajo el cuidado de su abuela, una mujer firme y de convicciones conservadoras. La llegada inesperada de su padre Rubén, después de años en prisión, trae consigo una mezcla de alivio por su presencia y complicaciones por las ambigüedades en su relación. - Ahora, Carmín se enfrenta a aprender a vivir entre el abandono y la cautela, mientras navega entre la ausencia, el deseo y el amor. programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.desc: Hefty Smurf learns what is to be handicapped when he breaks his leg. Handy Smurf creates the wheelsmurfer for him, a contraption that will give Hefty some mobility. But suddenly the evil wizard Gargamel appears on the scene.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha turns herself into a Smurf, plotting revenge on the little people for destroying her magic locket. Papa Smurf outwits her and banishes her from the forest once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Accidents do happen. This time it is Jokey Smurf's mistake that ends up with his shadow coming to independent life! And the shadow loves to play practical jokes on the whole population of the Village of the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf organizes a crew to sail to Smurfberry Island because Gargamel has killed all of the trees except one to trap the Smurfs. Gargamel follows them, but once more fails to catch them because the Witch of Smurfberry Island sends her nose-eating seagulls after them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa's note to the Smurfs about viewing a comet is delivered torn. The Smurfs read only the first part and think their world is coming to an end. They plan how to spend their last day until Papa returns to clear up the misunderstanding and assure them that they are safe.

programme.title: Monster Smurfs
programme.desc: This is spook-a-Smurf eve, and all the Smurfs get ready for the fancy dress party… But Brainy Smurf gets hold of Papa Smurf's Book of Magic, and all the Smurfs are changed into hideous but funny creatures. Yet danger lurks...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has saved Clumsy from a horrible fate. Clumsy swears eternal devotion to his savior and does his best to repay his debt… With awkward results. A clever scheme is needed to stop Clumsy's well-meant catastrophes...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey's surprise exploding packages have been changed by a spell. Picture the practical joker's discombobulating when he realises that all the surprises that he hands to unsuspecting Smurfs contain nothing but real gifts! No more ka-boom, no more jokes, no more fun! Plus the unenviable new position of Most Popular Smurf in the Village, surrounded by admirers begging for more presents...

programme.title: The Kaplowey Scroll
programme.desc: There is a terrifying magic word. When you direct the word at something or someone, you make it vanish into nothingness! Can the Smurfs undo its evil power before Gargamel gets hold of it?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Yes, there can be too much of a good thing. When an accident happens to Papa Smurf's magic formula and he ends up multiplied by two, the Smurfs are elated: two Papa Smurfs can give twice the good counsel and twice the loving that one can. But after a while, things get too complex in the Village. Especially when another accident doubles the number of Gargamels!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf recalls Dreamy's exciting voyage on the high seas and his gripping adventures with sea turtles, whales, desert islands... and pirates!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs love truffles but truffles belong to the Trolls and the Trolls live under Truffle Troll Mountain, where in the shadows of the lake lurks the Thing with No Name...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel has got hold of magical ectoplasmic crystal eggs that will enable him to change bodies with Papa Smurf. What better plan could there be? programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Grouchy learns that emotions can be great, particularly after the villainess of Chlorhydris creates a heart of ice to magically drain every one of care and love.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What a strange stone Clumsy has unearthed! In it, he can see events that are going to happen... Yet knowing part of the future sometimes brings bad luck!

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy and Smurfette are captured by the wicked Bombast, who plans to exhibit them in his sideshow. Papa Smurf hurries to their rescue and using the bungling Gargamel for interference is able to rescue his Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Bigmouth steals the Smurfs' winter food supply and Brainy concocts one of Papa Smurf's magic strength potions so he can fight the greedy giant. The super formula wears off, but Papa Smurf works a fast switch, replacing the food with rocks and Bigmouth is none the wiser.

programme.title: The Abominable Snowbeast
programme.desc: Brainy and his friends organize a journey to Ice Mountain to pick the rare snow flower for Papa Smurf. They meet a terrifying snow beast that befriends them, due to Smurfette's kindness, and helps them find the tiny flower.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel conjures a spell that makes Puppy think he's a cat. Papa receives a prescription from Homnibus to reverse the spell and all the Smurfs help. As Puppy becomes a dog again, Gargamel gets too close and he becomes a cat.

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: Journey To The Centre Of The Smurf
programme.desc: Winter is setting in on the Village of the Smurfs. The little Smurfs are freezing. But what is Clumsy doing with this strange rock he's discovered? The Smurfs will discover danger and surprises when they go underground.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: We all know Grouchy Smurf hates a lot of things. But one thing he hates more than anything else is water, when there is enough of it to drown in. You see, Grouchy can't swim. And when the Smurfs notice this peculiarity and try to teach him how to survive in water, the evil wizard Gargamel makes things a little more dangerous than they ought to be....

programme.title: Clumsy Luck
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn about superstition when Clumsy breaks Vanity's mirror prior to a meteor shower. When a meteor falls on Clumsy's house, everyone attributes it to bad luck, but realize the foolishness of this philosophy when they see Clumsy was not in the house at the time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While out on a mischief-making mission to destroy the Smurfs' Happy Halloween party, Gargamel and Hogatha catch Lazy who has been accidentally turned red by Mother Nature. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: Son Mektup
programme.desc: El capitán piloto Salih Ekrem es un joven oficial del aire y uno de los primeros pilotos otomanos. Ha perdido a su esposa durante el parto de su pequeña hija, Gülmelek. En febrero de 1915, con los primeros asaltos de la flota británica, Salih Ekrem confía a Gülmelek al cuidado de su abuela y abandona Estambul para ir a Galípoli, volando en «uno de los primeros aviones».

programme.title: Impacto lunar

programme.title: Amplify: USVI
programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: Roots & Rhythms: The Foundations of St. Croix Music
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI
programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: Sound of Revolution: Music as a Voice for Change
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas uncovers the revolutionary spirit woven into the music of St. Croix, where sound has long served as a rallying cry for justice and identity. Through the powerful perspectives of Mada Nile, Ras Attitude, Ras Bach, the Ay-Ay Cultural Dancers, and Kevin Williams, this episode explores how artists have used music to confront oppression, celebrate resilience, and inspire change — from the island’s historic struggles to its modern-day movements.

programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: The Global Stage: St. Croix Blowing Up
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy digs into a world of flavors all over the United States from amazing Asian in Georgia and tasty tacos in Texas to lights-out Lebanese in Utah.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri grabs serious sandwiches from an Austin rock-n-roll brunch bar, a Texas joint putting '90s hip hop into their stacked up specialties, and a bakery in Pasco, WA, serving up a killer Cuban and off-the-chain chicken.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's in Oklahoma City, where a funky food truck turns out wood-fired pizza and Grandma's Sicilian meatball recipe. In Fort Lauderdale, FL, he chills with Vanilla Ice at a pirate-inspired joint serving up Brazilian and Caribbean seafood.

programme.title: Sonic X

programme.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
programme.desc: Mario and friends are invited to the Flower Kingdom by its ruler, Prince Florian, when Bowser suddenly appears, along with Kamek and Bowser Jr.! Bowser then takes hold of the Wonder Flower, merging himself, his Koopa Clown Car, and Prince Florian's castle to become a flying fortress, wreaking havoc across the land and trapping the Poplins in their homes. Abdallah plays as Mario and friends and sets off on a journey to defeat Bowser and save the Flower Kingdom in Super Mario Bros. Wonder on Nintendo Switch with family-friendly commentary.

On this episode of Others Receiving Votes, Sports Illustrated's Pat Forde and Bryan Fischer are joined by former longtime College Gameday Reporter Gene Wojciechowski to break down the firing of Penn State Head Coach James Franklin after the teams loss to Northwestern, their third straight. They also breakdown whether Penn State is in position to be a championship contender in the Big Ten and for the College Football National Championship before giving their thoughts on who Penn State should turn to next, bringing up Curt Cignetti of Indiana and the tough choice he could have this offseason. After that, they give out their Midseason Awards for Heisman, Flop, Surprise, Coach and Team of the half season while also talking about some of the dumbest ideas that were brought up by the masses during the first half of the college football season. They finish things off with a view at some of the big games this weekend, giving their picks and some background on each matchup including a few games that could have College Football Playoff implications in USC vs. Notre Dame, BYU vs. Utah and Alabama vs. Tennessee.

programme.desc: Step into the handmade world of Horndribbles, a - documentary where puppeteer Lucas Richards builds - more than characters—he builds connection, - community, and meaning through the art of puppetry. Directed by Savannah Warrick.

programme.title: All Things Metal
programme.desc: Three blacksmith brothers operate an iron forge where they explore craft, music, and a life of creativity together.

programme.title: Mississippi River Styx
programme.desc: An enigmatic drifter with terminal cancer lives his dream of floating the Mississippi Rive on a ramshackle houseboat - until locals start to question his story. Directed by Tim Grant and Andy McMillan.

programme.title: We Are Oscar Mike
programme.desc: Through his non-profit foundation, Oscar Mike, Noah helps rehabilitate other veterans through the adaptive sports that saved his own life. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: Down Again - Censored
programme.desc: DOWN AGAIN is an examination of the connection between mental illness and creativity told through the lens of photographer and Chimaira frontman Mark Hunter, exploring the catharsis of making music and how the art affects the fans.

programme.title: The Final 19
programme.desc: The true story of Sgt. Daniel Hefel, one of the last 19 POWs to return.

programme.title: Entrapped
programme.desc: The FBI claimed it exposed a dangerous group of men in a massive entrapment operation over an alleged plot to attack a U.S. Army base in New Jersey. But were they really terrorists? Directed by Razan Ghalayini.

programme.title: Flint: The Poisoning of an American City
programme.desc: Interviews with residents and experts in lead and water, Flint serves as a warning for the nation.

programme.title: Deep Web
programme.desc: The deep web caught the attention of the world with the arrest of Ross William Ulbricht - the convicted entrepreneur accused of being 'Dread Pirate Roberts'. This documentary seeks to unravel the web of secrecy, accusation, and criminal activity surrounding Ulbricht, and also explores how the outcome his trial set a precedent for the future of technological freedom. Directed by Alex Winter.

programme.title: In My Own Words
programme.sub-title: In My Own Words: Rannel Ngumuya
programme.desc: DOCUMENTARY+ invited Rannel Ngumuya to share a personal story. Rannel Ngumuya is a graphic designer, artist, NFT entrepreneur, and founder of breakout band Bungalo Boy, whose artistic endeavors helped him break through barriers as a first generation immigrant and DACA recipient. Directed by Victor Kamwendo & Yasir Masood.

programme.title: Muxes
programme.desc: In the southern state of Oaxaca where, in the indigenous communities around the town of Juchitán, the world is not divided simply into males and females. The local Zapotec people have made room for a third category, which they call “muxes” - men who consider themselves women and live in a socially sanctioned limbo between the two genders. Directed by Ivan Olita.

programme.title: Picture Locked
programme.sub-title: Picture Locked: Chris Temple & Zach Ingrasci
programme.desc: Filmmakers Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci break down their work, including "Five Years North." Directed by Yasir Masood & Victor Kamwendo.

programme.title: Dancer Boy
programme.desc: When Lou Wilson makes fun of Parker Seaman's dancing, Parker (a grown man) signs up to compete in a children's dance contest to prove to Lou, everyone and even to himself, that he's a great dancer. Directed by Parker Seaman.

programme.title: Brainstorm: Unraveling The Mysteries Of The Brain
programme.desc: Small-town neuroscientists revolutionize our understanding of the brain.

programme.title: Pickle Man
programme.desc: Facing certain death by ALS, Arthur Cohen decides to leave a legacy of pickles. PickALS, that is. Arthur is brilliant, hilarious and courageous in this intimate portrait of a man facing a brutal disease. Directed by Nastasya Popov.

programme.title: Groundwork: A Family Journey Into Regenerative Cotton
programme.desc: When a family cotton farm defies the conventions holding them back—they embark on a journey of transformation that radically shifts their farm, their family, and their future. Directed by Lindsey Hagen.

programme.title: Joyce
programme.desc: An experimental documentary film exploring themes of aging, faith, family and time. Directed by Ruby Stocking, Toby Mullinkosson, and Bobby Moser.

programme.title: Ninety-five Senses Block
programme.desc: Narrated by Tim Blake Nelson, this is an ode to the body's five senses delivered by a man with little time left to enjoy them. An Oscar nominated DOCUMENTARY+ Original. Directed by Jared and Jerusha Hess.

programme.title: Quiet Minds Silent Streets
programme.desc: Quiet Minds Silent Streets introduces viewers to a community that has been chronically affected by gun violence. This thoughtful, eye-opening documentary asks whether they can find a new way forward with a relatively simple technique: mindfulness and meditation. Executive produced by Director X and directed by Karen Chapman.

programme.title: Fostering Hope: A Dog Rescuer's Story
programme.desc: The heartwarming, difficult, and rewarding story of an animal advocate at the top of her game.

programme.title: Picture Locked
programme.desc: Filmmakers Bryan and Amy Storkel breakdown their documentary "Holy Rollers" which follows a blackjack team of devoted card-counting Christians as they win millions from casinos. Directed by Yasir Masood & James Rohan.

programme.title: The Blessings Of Aging
programme.desc: The sweet and sassy residents of a retirement community explain the many upsides of getting older. Directed by Jenny Schweitzer Bell.

programme.title: A Swim Lesson
programme.desc: A SWIM LESSON is an ode to an everyday hero: Bill Marsh, a swim teacher who helps children manage their fears and discover their own power when submerged in an overwhelming unknown.

programme.title: Future Forward Supercut
programme.desc: Future Forward is a character-driven documentary series featuring people and businesses pioneering industry innovation on the front lines of climate change. Each film profiles visionaries fighting for their dream of a better world, the complex hurdles to igniting corporate change on a global scale, and a contagious hope—and inspiration—for the future.

programme.title: Muxes
programme.desc: In the southern state of Oaxaca where, in the indigenous communities around the town of Juchitán, the world is not divided simply into males and females. The local Zapotec people have made room for a third category, which they call “muxes” - men who consider themselves women and live in a socially sanctioned limbo between the two genders. Directed by Ivan Olita.

programme.title: No More Secrets
programme.desc: Addiction isn't a choice. Recovery Is. No More Secrets offers hope to families caught in the turmoil of addiction, shining a light on the struggles, resilience, and recovery of those battling the disease. Directed by Chris Temple.

programme.title: In My Own Words
programme.sub-title: In My Own Words: Little Big
programme.desc: DOCUMENTARY+ invited Ilya Prusikin to share their personal story. Ilya is a musician, songwriter, and lead vocalist of the Russian pop-rave superband, Little Big. Ilya recounts the on the ground events of February 24th, the day Russia invaded Ukraine, the group's journey to seek political asylum in the United States, and navigating being labeled a traitor by the Russian government for being outspoken against the war. Directed by Yasir Masood.

programme.title: Five Years North
programme.desc: Five Years North is the coming-of-age story of Luis, an undocumented Guatemalan boy who just arrived alone in New York City. Directed by Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci.

programme.title: NF Forward: The Pearson Twins
programme.desc: Identical twins, Adam and Neil Pearson, are navigating life in South London with a rare genetic disorder, neurofibromatosis. Despite their identical DNA, the twins are affected in vastly different ways. The one thing that remains the same is their perspective of life and how to live it best. Directed by Jonathan Braue.

programme.title: Elder
programme.desc: A Mormon missionary finds his world turned upside down when he falls in love with a handsome, Italian Communist. With original 8mm film Tom Clark recounts a love story on the coast of Italy. Directed by Genéa Gaudet.

programme.title: Eat Flowers
programme.desc: Eat Flowers picks up in 2017 as photographer Cig Harvey’s best friend Mary is diagnosed with a rare form of leukemia. When forced to isolate during her treatment, she asks Cig to send her photographs. Everyday Cig sets out to bring color and life to Mary through her camera. Everyday Mary asks for more. ‘Eat Flowers’ brings us into the vibrant worlds that Cig creates for her. Directed by River Finlay

programme.title: Eleanor Ambos Interiors
programme.desc: As a celebrated interior designer loses her eyesight to macular degeneration, she begins to see her life's work in a new light. This eccentric renegade topples ageist stereotypes as she grapples with the limitations of her aging body. Directed by Katrina Sorrentino and Andrew Ellis.

programme.title: My Dearest Artsakh
programme.desc: Distanced from her home, displaced Armenian teenager Knar grieves her time in Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabak).

programme.title: Bodega De Edgar
programme.desc: The courageous story of Edgar Torres immigrating to the US illegally with his father in the 80’s, becoming a wine expert and starting a winery in Paso Robles, CA to give his children a better future. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: Osama & Ayman
programme.desc: Osama and Ayman Abdeldayem skate through the streets of our nation's capital, while navigating growing Islamophobia with style and humor. Directed by Ben Mullinkosson, Sam Price-Waldman, and Chris Cresci.

programme.title: A Fat Wreck: The Punk-u-mentary
programme.desc: Fat Wreck Chords... The influential music label proud to say they’ve spent the past 25 years “ruining punk rock”. A Fat Wreck tells the story of founders Fat Mike (of the legendary punk band NOFX) and his ex-wife Erin Kelly-Burkett, spanning the birth, growth, struggles, and survival of the Fat Wreck Chords label. Half inspirational story of chosen family and community, half debauchery and occasionally involuntary drug use... A Fat Wreck blazes exciting new ground in the cinematic genre of puppet-driven punk rock music documentary filmmaking. If you only see one film featuring a dominatrix spanking a puppet in your lifetime... Make it A Fat Wreck! Directed by Shaun M. Colón.

programme.title: Mala Onda - Censored
programme.desc: Farm animals are being killed all across Puerto Rico and no one knows what's going on. The animals are found with two circular incisions, but no blood. Experts from different backgrounds, farmers who lost animals, and eye witness's explain what they think is happening. Is the Chupacabra a symbol of destruction or a cause for unity? Directed by Danilo Parra. A DOCUMENTARY+ Original.

programme.desc: Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

programme.title: Martha Cooks
programme.desc: Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

programme.title: Martha Cooks
programme.desc: Restaurant owners Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli join Martha in making their rolled lasagna with San Marzano tomato sauce, Italian bolognese, and chrysanthemum Caesar salad.

programme.title: Martha Cooks
programme.desc: Martha, Monica Tran Carden, and Andrew Yu make homemade dumplings; Martha and Monica hand-make wontons and pork dumplings; Andrew and Martha prepare jade dumplings and pork and shrimp dumplings.

programme.title: Martha Stewart Living
programme.desc: Cats, Bats, Ghosts, Goblins: Spooky Plants, Halloween Veils, Halloween Pop-Up Card, White Chocolate Ghosts, Collecting Halloween Memorabilia with Pamela, Spicy Bat Wings, Sphynx Cat Breed

programme.title: Martha Stewart Living
programme.desc: Best of Pumpkins: Pumpkin Flower Pots, Pumpkin Flan, Chicken Pot Pie in a Pumpkin, Pumpkin Seed Salad, Heirloom Pumpkins (Field Trip), Pumpkin Carving Basics

programme.title: Martha Stewart Living
programme.desc: Halloween for Kids: Creepy-Crawly Tablecloth, Pina Ghoul-ada Punch, Kids' Capes, Jones Tree Farm (Field Trip), Pumpkin Owl Craft, Nocturnal Pets, Eye-Popping Tomato Soup, Cookie Sand-Witches

programme.title: Martha Gardens
programme.desc: Meet Martha's chickens! Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock. Then learn the how-tos of building the a coop.

programme.title: Martha Gardens
programme.sub-title: Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
programme.desc: Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

programme.title: Martha Gardens
programme.desc: Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; join Martha while she creates new garden with almost 200 roses.

programme.title: Martha Gardens
programme.desc: Welcome to Martha's woodland gardens. Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring. Everything you need to know about hostas. Martha takes up bird watching.

programme.title: Martha Gardens
programme.sub-title: Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
programme.desc: Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began in the 1970s. Then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour for a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

programme.title: Martha Gardens
programme.desc: One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year. Bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

programme.title: Martha Gardens
programme.sub-title: Martha's Amazing Maze; How to Grow Trees
programme.desc: Welcome to Martha's passion project: the maze on her Bedford farm. Learn how to properly plant trees including measuring, fertilizing, and watering. Plus, how to start trees from seedlings.

programme.title: 2025 Elite Season
programme.sub-title: 2025 Elite at St. Johns River Live Day 4
programme.desc: Championship day coverage of the FXR Pro Fish Bassmaster Elite on the St. Johns River located in Palatka, Florida. Follow along as the top anglers in the world battle to see who is crowned the Bassmaster Elite Champion on the St. Johns River.

programme.title: 2025 Elite Season
programme.sub-title: 2025 Elite at St. Johns River Weigh-in Day 4
programme.desc: Join Dave Mercer and Lisa Talmadge as the top anglers in the world weigh in their 5 largest bass at the St. Johns River in Palatka, Florida. The 10 anglers remaining compete for the top spot and $100,000 in the first event of the 2025 Progressive Bassmaster Elite season.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.desc: The 2021 Bassmaster Elite Series professional fishing tour started the year in Florida and Tennessee. See how the pros mastered the St. Johns River and Fort Loudoun.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Stetson Blaylock
programme.desc: Stetson Blaylock explains a new bait he was introduced to that helps him catch not only deep northern smallmouth but also southern largemouth in the winter months. He also discusses the value in 2D sonar with this technique around structure in the south.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.sub-title: 2022 Florida Swing Recap: St. Johns & Harris Chain
programme.desc: The 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series kicked off the season in Florida with back to back events at the St. Johns River and Harris Chain of Lakes.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Trey McKinney
programme.desc: Lake Fork Champion Trey McKinney gives his lure arsenal as he adjusted daily to the changing fish for the second stop of the Elite Series season. Early in the event he used a jerkbait and jig head minnow combo but as the weather warm and conditions changed his baits adapted. Culminating on the final day were multiple baits contributed to his 130-15 tournament weight.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.desc: The third and fourth events of the 2024 Bassmaster Elite Series season took place in Florida at the Harris Chain of Lakes and the St. Johns River.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Matt Arey
programme.desc: Matt Arey talks about the importance of varying your retrieve with swimbaits over structure like brush piles. This is something that can be done with or without forward facing sonar as Arey describes the trial and error used prior to newer technology.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Crews
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Johns River went to ‪@JohnCrews‬ as he led wire to wire to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch his week from behind the lens as he strived for another major tournament victory as a professional fisherman.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie Classic
programme.desc: A story a decade in the making unfolded at the 2022 Bassmaster Classic when ‪@Christiefishing‬ notched his first Classic victory at Lake Hartwell. Watch Christie's Marathon Peak Performance from start to finish as he climbed the mountain in the sport of bass fishing and achieved the biggest win in the sport.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Cook
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Drew Cook (‪@thecutlinetv‬) has been a strong competitor since joining the Elite Series in 2019, but a win has eluded him early in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: In this Marathon Peak Performance, we take a look at Brandon Palaniuk's amazing 2022 season en route to his second Angler of the Year title.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: In his 8-year Bassmaster Elite Series career, Brock Mosley has been so close to major titles but fallen just short with 5 2nd place finishes and even more Top 10’s. Watch Mosley put four great days together on his way to his first Elite Series title at the 2023 Folds of Honor Bassmaster Elite at the Sabine River and take home the Marathon Peak Performance!

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. The former College Champion and current Elite Series rookie led wire to wire and got his first blue trophy in just his 3rd event of the season.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Takumi Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito got another blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series with his big win at Smith Lake. Relive his week in Alabama where he conquered spotted bass en route to his second Elite Series win since joining the top ranks in 2020.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). In the co-main event of the evening, GLORY Welterweight World Champion Chico Kwasi (43-5-1, 23 KO) is set to defend his title against number two ranked welterweight Teodor Hristov (18-3, 7 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Former Light Heavyweight Champion Tarik Khbabez (52-12-1, 22 KO) and Bahram Rajabzabeh (72-5, 63 KO) collide in a huge showdown for the vacant Light Heavyweight title. The penultimate round of the Last Heavyweight Standing tournament resumes with eight heavyweights competing in two separate four-man one-night tournaments. Notable participants include Levi Rigters (20-3, 10 KO), Nabil Khachab (30-6-1, 4 KO), Rade Opacic (22-7, 17 KO) and Milos Cvjeticanin (14-4, 9 KO).

programme.desc: Can the everyday landowner really manage their property well enough to hold and retain mature bucks year after year? From habitat improvements and food plots to pressure control and property layout, discover what truly influences a buck’s decision to stay—or stray.

programme.title: Pure Hunting

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "175" Georgia MONSTER BUCK | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hunts one of the biggest bucks on Realtree Farms with his brother Colton. Colton and his Dad Bill, have seen this buck several times over the last few days not he and Tyler make a move hoping to get Colton a shot at this giant Georgia whitetail.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nobody chases the waterfowl migration as hard as Shawn Stahl of Team Winchester. The Michigan native spends over half of his year running the highways and flyways searching for the x. In this episode, we’ll tag along with Shawn and his crew with their Winchester pumps in hand as they hunker down hiding in fields and timber in hopes of locked wings from ducks and geese.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Waterfowl Hunting at 15,000 Feet | , South American Waterfowl Slam"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson finishes the South America Waterfowl Slam in the Andes at 15,000 feet elevation. With only 2 days left, he is able to capitalize on every opportunity and take the remaining 6 species needed on the list of 20. It's been an incredible journey, and it all comes down to this!

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.

programme.title: Abhimaan
programme.desc: Subir, a popular singer in show business, encourages his wife and a talented singer, Uma to take up singing as a career. However, his pride is wounded and their marital bliss is threatened when Uma's popularity surpasses his own.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul is heavily indebted and has to bring up his two notorious nephews and a niece. One day, the kids go to a carnival and befriend a runaway bride. Trouble ensues when they decide to help her by bringing her home and keep her out of Rahul's sight.

programme.title: Ekkees Tareekh Shubh Muhurat
programme.desc: A 55-year-old aspiring storyteller wanting to escape his family legacy of becoming a priest. His dream comes true in an unexpected way, when he is jailed and he finds an audience amongst the prisoners.

programme.title: Baatein Kahi Ankahi
programme.desc: Watch Baatein Kahi Ankahi with RJ Anmol In An Exclusive Interview With Bollywood Stars.

programme.title: Bluff Master
programme.desc: Ashok, a smooth-talking con-artist, aspires to lead a life of honesty, when he falls in love with Seema. However, when his past is exposed to Seema, he must not only try to win his lady love back but also protect her from the ghosts of his past.

programme.title: Dil Jo Na Keh Saka
programme.desc: The story revolves around two childhood friends, go their separate ways in pursuit of their dreams. Coincidentally, they return to their hometown and meet after a long separation only to realize that they were missing each other.

programme.title: Dhamaal
programme.desc: Four slack and vagabond conmen learn about a hidden treasure from a dying thief and race against time to claim it. Meanwhile, they are also being pursued by a determined police inspector who is hell-bent on finding the treasure and keeping it all to himself.

programme.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.
